ma.exitMiniProgram(Object object)

exit the current miniProgram (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Parameters

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
clearCache Boolean false No Whether to clear the cache
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function that ends the interface invoking. (This function is executed when the interface is successfully invoked or fails to be invoked.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String exitMiniProgram: ok

Sample Code

ma.exitMiniProgram({
  clearCache: false,
  success: (res) => {
    console.log(res);
  },
  fail: (err) => {
    console.log(err);
  }
});
